num_jobs: <int> Number of jobs to be processed in the facility.
num_machines: <int> Number of machines available in the facility.
preemption_allowed: <bool> Whether an operation may be interrupted and resumed later on the same machine.
migration_allowed: <bool> Whether an interrupted operation may resume on a different machine than the one it was assigned to.

operations.operation_id: <int> Zero-based position of the operation within its job, defining the required processing order.
operations.eligible_machines: <list[int], length num_eligible_machines> Zero-based indices of machines that can perform this operation.
operations.processing_times: <dict, key: '{machine_id}'> Time periods required to complete this operation on each eligible machine.
